comparison_basis: same-split text baseline from fusion_results.csv vs best fusion vs best trimodal
notes: Image synthetics are intentionally hard (shared palette + noise); prefer LMVD landmark images when available.
Fusion uses mild class-weighted CE + F1-based early stopping; text-only baseline uses the same stratified split.
Fair unimodal-vs-fusion comparison prefers fusion_results.csv same-split text baseline over cross-run transformers.
Trimodal captions are expression-derived only (no label leakage); subsets are stratified; checkpoints selected by f1_macro.
No raw LMVD wav/transcripts in-repo; AV alignment uses VGGish energy vs OpenFace AU intensity proxies.
